Docs / API / parseConfig

parseConfig(text, options?)

Reads a configuration file and returns a frozen object. Unknown keys are an error unless options.strict is false.

Parameters

NameTypeDescription
textstringThe file's contents.
options{ strict?: boolean }Defaults to { strict: true }.

Example

const cfg = parseConfig(readFileSync('app.toml', 'utf8'));
if (cfg.port < 1024 && !cfg.root) throw new Error('privileged port');
console.log(`listening on ${cfg.port}`);

Errors

  • ConfigSyntaxError — the text is not valid TOML.
  • ConfigKeyError — an unknown key with strict on.

Note: HTML in values is kept verbatim: <b>bold</b> stays as typed.
